name: Manastorm: a group member who follows through the stage portal keeps their Necromancer companions (#11015)
contract: Player report (#11015): in a group, a Necromancer lost the Crypt Fiend and Skeletal Archers on every floor
change, while solo they stayed. Only the first member to cross the stage portal is moved by PrepareStage; every
other member follows later through TransferMemberToCurrentStage, which captured no companions before #11035
This Duo case makes the Necromancer the follower: n1 kills the segment 1 objective and clicks the stage portal
(80910) at once, so n1 crosses first and n2, who stays at the entrance, follows through the five-second
fallback. n2 must arrive with the companions cast before the crossing: one Crypt Fiend (50323) and three
